meeting: Post Quantum Transaction Signature (PQTS) Breakout #14 - September 2, 2026

slh_dsa_parameter_overview.highlight: SLH-DSA chosen as PQ replacement for ECDSA; no cryptographic precompiles will be shipped; aligns with hash-based consensus/DA layer direction
Moving away from Poseidon toward Blake/SHA via new 'Flock' system on Banner Fields; specific hash function TBD
NIST April 2026 SLH-DSA variant cuts signature from ~8KB to ~4KB but requires 1.45B hashes to sign — impractical for hardware wallets
SLH-DSA Minus C12 targets 2^14 signature budget (covers 99.99% of mainnet addresses); signing cost 37K hashes vs. 1.45B; still 47.5s on Ledger Nano S
Riva Labs achieved 1.5s signing on Ledger Nano S Plus (2^24 budget) via offline precomputation of public values + grinding; paper forthcoming

pq1_hardware_wallet_demo.highlight: Freedom Factory PQ1 wallet: STM32U585 (Cortex-M33) + NXPSE050 secure element; XOR key split via TrustZone; SLH-DSA Minus C10
On-chip signing: ~1.1s; cold boot (with key derivation): ~3s; SHA-256 hardware accelerator on STM32 aids performance
First EVT hardware received; all code open source (WIP); STM32U585 eval board ~$100 total to run today
Targeting Q4 2026 consumer device availability; uses account abstraction (modified base smart account), not native ECDSA replacement
Verification contract in Trail of Bits audit; exploring Lean/eCrypt formal verification via Rust-to-Lean toolchain

mldsa_evm_optimization.highlight: Fireblocks (Oren): MLDSA-44 EVM verification reduced from ~8M gas to 1.2M gas (6× improvement); FIPS-compliant, open source, research quality
Key registration (one-time expanded key stored on-chain, ~20KB) costs ~4M gas; full cold verification ~9M gas unoptimized
Main savings: eliminating quadratic memory expansion (~2M gas saved), 256-bit batched lane operations, Yul/assembly rewrites; ~10% further reduction possible
At current gas prices, 1.2M gas verification costs ~$0.22; contract to be published same day or next
Result supports community position against MLDSA precompile for Hegota; pure EVM sufficient at this gas cost

action_items.action: Publish optimized MLDSA-44 EVM verification contract to announced repository
Share Lean/eCrypt formal verification progress for SLH-DSA firmware with community

decisions.decision: No cryptographic precompiles (MLDSA, Falcon, etc.) to be shipped; EVM optimization results validate this direction
Native account abstraction (frame transactions replacing EOA) is SFI for Hegota

targets.target: PQ1 hardware wallet consumer release — Q4 2026
Optimized MLDSA-44 EVM contract published — September 2–3, 2026
